Available capacity after operating ceiling and availability
Rust markers: monthly demand exceeds available capacity. All plotted volumes use actual calendar days.
Pressure basis: shared formation reference depth. Curves above the assumed limit are excluded rates, not available capacity.
Monthly planning / reconciliation — bbl unless stated; displayed values rounded, exact values retained in SVG
Public reported evidence — separate from fictional planning
Artifact ID: rrc-2026-10-09-uic000020838-v1; 28 monthly source rows; 5 bounded inventory candidates.
Monthly liquid injection and pressure are public reported; calendar-day average is calculated. Missing observations remain
source-reported psi; basis unspecified; never used as bottomhole pressure
availableCapacity: min(pressureCapacity, operatingCeiling)*availability + explicitly assumed available expansion
monthlyVolume: calendar-day average rate * actual calendar days
variance: synthetic actual volume - frozen forecast volume
Forecast frozen at 2025-12; new-well schedule edits do not change actuals or fitted forecast.
Injectivity is fixed with pressure and time; no fracture, transient, layered or calibrated well model.
Assumed pressure limit is bottomhole psia, not a copied surface permit maximum.
Additional expansion is available stock-tank capacity after downtime; no implicit availability multiplier.
Nexus brine density uses temperature/salinity and ignores pressure; FVF/salinity and viscosity use simplified correlations and
Public reported liquid injection is not assigned to synthetic producers or fictional injectors.
